info.name: gsm-system 2.1 / 2.1 API
info.description:
The /api/v1-only contract. Send manually to execute a request; no additional client enable switches are required. Preset CRUD persists data but never starts a cell. New stores contain editable defaults 0–4. The CRUD fixture uses lab-900 and does not edit/delete defaults. Use only the Read-only folder for read-only inspection; do not Run the whole collection because starts, deletes and SMS submissions have real side effects. HTTP 202 for SMS means submitted, never delivered. Replace placeholders; never commit real hosts, IMSIs, phone numbers or Tokens. network names the container interface (default eth0), not a host NIC.

仅包含 /api/v1，手动点击 Send 即执行，无额外启用开关。新库包含五套预设，CRUD使用独立lab-900且不启动小区。只读检查仅运行查询分组；不要全量运行集合，启动、删除和短信提交会真实执行。所有真实主机与敏感数据留在私有环境中。

Preset and Custom start are separate requests. start_preset_id selects any stored preset; default_preset_id is for read-only queries and preset_id remains the CRUD fixture. All custom fields are variables, including band and short_name. Malformed, unresolved or incomplete start inputs are explained in the Console before skipping; valid inputs send directly. Variable lookup respects scope precedence, including an empty optional Token. / 预设和自定义分开，三个预设相关变量各司其职；有效请求直接发送，参数问题会在 Console 提示后跳过。空 Token 按作用域覆盖集合值。

Exact factory assertions use verify_factory_defaults=true only for response checking; this option never gates sending. / verify_factory_defaults 仅控制精确工厂值响应断言，不影响请求发送。

request.description: Control-plane health, version/revision, cell state; not RF acceptance. / 管理面健康，不是射频验收。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 stopped health', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.version).to.eql('2.1.0'); pm.expect(d.cell.state).to.eql('stopped'); pm.expect(d.cell.ready).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('HTTP 200 stopped process snapshot', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.state).to.eql('stopped'); pm.expect(d.ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.sms_ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.voice_ready).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.running).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('HTTP 200 no saved profile', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.has_profile).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d).not.to.have.property('profile'); });
pm.test('HTTP 200: seeded OpenBTS DB exists', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('config is a non-empty key/value array', function () { const a=pm.response.json().data.config; pm.expect(a).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(a[0].key).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(a[0].value).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Volatile registration/TMSI observation, not an admitted or online-device list. number_source is optional and nullable: subscriber_registry is authoritative for both bindings and unbindings, openbts_tmsi is the native fallback, and inconsistent_registry forces number=null rather than guessing. The top-level source remains openbts_tmsi_sgsn. auth and reject_code are additive nullable integers and may be absent during a rolling 2.1 upgrade. AUTH is a native recorded value, not a real-time online indicator; auth=0 means authentication has not succeeded. reject_code=4 alone has multiple possible causes and does not prove a Ki mismatch. ip=null means no handset GPRS/PDP address was observed and does not prove NAT failure; SMS uses signalling and does not depend on this IP. / 易失注册/TMSI 观察，不是已入网或在线名单。number_source 可选且可空：subscriber_registry 对绑定和解绑均为权威来源，openbts_tmsi 为原生回退，inconsistent_registry 会将 number 置空而不猜测冲突值。顶层 source 仍为 openbts_tmsi_sgsn。滚动升级期间 auth、reject_code 可缺省；存在时为可空整数。AUTH 是原生记录值而非实时在线指标，0 表示鉴权未成功；仅凭拒绝码 4 不能断定 Ki 错误。ip=null 仅表示未观察到手机 GPRS/PDP 地址，不证明 NAT 失败，短信也不依赖该 IP。

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('connections snapshot and additive native fields', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.connections).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.connections.length); pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('openbts_tmsi_sgsn'); pm.expect(d.window).to.eql('current_snapshot'); pm.expect(d.truncated).to.eql(false); d.connections.forEach(function (c) { ['imsi','imei','number','ip'].forEach(k => pm.expect(c).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(Object.keys(c).every(k => ['imsi','imei','number','number_source','ip','auth','reject_code'].includes(k))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(c.imsi).to.be.a('string'); ['imei','number','ip'].forEach(k => pm.expect(c[k] === null || typeof c[k] === 'string').to.eql(true)); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c,'number_source')) pm.expect(c.number_source === null || ['subscriber_registry','openbts_tmsi','inconsistent_registry'].includes(c.number_source)).to.eql(true); if (c.number_source === 'inconsistent_registry') pm.expect(c.number).to.eql(null); ['auth','reject_code'].forEach(function (k) { if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(c,k)) pm.expect(c[k] === null || Number.isInteger(c[k])).to.eql(true); }); }); });
pm.test('HTTP 200: seeded registry DB exists', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('clean registry is an empty paginated snapshot', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.subscribers).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(100); pm.expect(d.offset).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('asterisk_registry'); pm.expect(d.window).to.eql('full'); pm.expect(d.truncated).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Replace IMSI placeholder with a 15-digit dedicated test IMSI.

exec: pm.test('HTTP 404: example IMSI is absent from clean seed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

request.description: Preferentially parses keyed GSM_SMS_V1 NOTICE observations whose qtag_hex/from_hex/to_hex/text_hex fields preserve exact content and prevent log-line injection, then merges matching legacy NOTICE evidence by qtag within one smqueue process generation. Older Got SMS rqst qtag events retain evidenced time and parties, but unkeyed text remains null and is never associated; explicitly keyed text and complete local detailed logs remain supported. Records are deduplicated by message identity/qtag, never by content; identical text may therefore appear more than once. Missing evidence is null and rows are not delivery receipts. / 优先解析 GSM_SMS_V1 结构化 NOTICE；qtag/收发方/正文使用 hex 字段，准确保留内容并防日志行注入，再按同一 smqueue 进程代际内的 qtag 合并旧 NOTICE 证据。旧 GotSMS 仅保留有证据的时间与收发方；不带身份的正文一律保持 null 且不关联，显式 keyed 正文及完整局部详细日志继续支持。按消息身份/qtag 去重而非按内容；同文消息可分别出现。无证据字段为空，记录不是送达回执。

exec: pm.test('HTTP 200 observations or 404 before log activity', () => pm.expect([200,404]).to.include(pm.response.code));

if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('SMS snapshot keeps six nullable fields and counts', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; const keys=['time','text','sender_number','sender_imsi','receiver_number','receiver_imsi']; pm.expect(d.sms).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.count).to.eql(d.sms.length); pm.expect(d.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(d.count).to.be.at.most(d.total); pm.expect(d.source).to.eql('smqueue.log'); pm.expect(d.window).to.be.an('object'); d.sms.forEach(function (m) { pm.expect(Object.keys(m).sort()).to.eql(keys.slice().sort()); keys.forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(m[k] === null || typeof m[k] === 'string').to.eql(true); }); }); });

request.description: Persists data only; does not start or reconfigure the cell. / 仅持久化，不启动或重配小区。
Replaces name, description, and complete params only; body id is not accepted. / 仅替换名称、说明和完整参数。

exec: pm.test('authoritative binding consistent', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.subscriber.number).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{number}}')); pm.expect(d.subscriber.binding_consistent).to.eql(true); pm.expect(['updated','not_present','unavailable','failed']).to.include(d.tmsi_projection); });

request.description: Authoritative Asterisk transaction; TMSI projection is best effort.
Maximum 159 bytes from safe ASCII/basic GSM intersection. 202 is submitted, not delivered.

exec: pm.test('runtime-only rule', function () { const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.rule_present).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.persisted).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.changed).to.be.a('boolean'); pm.expect([true,false,null]).to.include(d.ipv4_forwarding); });
pm.test('HTTP 422 repeated query', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.code).to.eql(42201); pm.expect(b.data.errors[0].field).to.eql('limit'); });
